setup: upright: the servo standing with its shaft horizontal, the printed arm hanging from the horn as a pendulum, 20 US quarters in its two top pockets (10 each); the plumb is the arm hanging straight down and gravity pulls it back toward the plumb; the horn tag on the arm's hub, the reference tag on the servo body. Position mode, holds of 1.5 s at the plumb (1937, 1967) and away from it (2541, 1367, 2772, 1162). This block is the clip's last cell, run with goal_duty 0, the setting that leaves the pot reading uncorrected; the clip's four earlier cells ran a reading correction and are left out, and so are their frames. Clapper of 12 flashes at the clip's start and 12 at its end; the STAT trace is whole.

image.where: a scratch image (438e4a5a plus a pot reading correction set from goal_duty, version 0.1.40) on no pushed branch: it exists only on local scratch branches of the firmware checkout. This cell ran with goal_duty 0.

loop: closed loop (Position mode) found data: the loop only excites the shake and sets the holds; the measurement is the pot against the camera, which does not depend on it
track_columns: track.csv keeps the 9 columns the analysis reads, every row; the dropped columns are goal (segments.csv carries it), current, vdiff, vbus, vbus_raw, ntc_raw, vref_raw
lens: stage 3 pot-table's portrait lens (pot-table/crawl-9/camera.json), the same phone; these clips carry no board views of their own
